title.narrative: CBOs demonstrate improved financial accountability, resource mobilisation, and advocacy capacity
Number of trained CBOs demonstrating improved financial management systems

target.value: 22 CBOs participating CBO trained in financial management

actual.value: 20 CBO participants were trained in financial management. Post-training webinars confirmed implementation efforts, including structured financial record-keeping system

target.value: All the 20 completed training on resource mobilization, fundraising, donor mapping, proposal writing, storytelling, and pitching

actual.value: 90% of participants were trained in financial management. Post-training webinars confirmed implementation efforts, including structured financial record-keeping system

title.narrative: 22 members of waste picker CBOs complete a 10-day training course on financial management, resource mobilisation, and public policy influencing and advocacy
Strengthened participant capacity through delivery of a 10-day training programme

target.value: 23 participants completing the 10-day training and submitting relevant course documents.

actual.value: 20 participants completed the training and participated in post-training evaluation

target.value: Improved availability of practical learning tools for CBO capacity development

actual.value: Multiple tools and exercises were used, including cashbook templates, budgeting exercises, donor mapping, proposal writing exercises, storytelling, pitching, stakeholder mapping, personas, and advocacy strategy tool training evaluation for 20 participants.

title.narrative: CBOs demonstrate improved financial accountability, resource mobilisation, and advocacy capacity
Enhanced resource mobilization capacity among participating wastepickers CBOs.
